en: Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square bordered by multi‑storey historic buildings. On the right is a town hall with a clock‑tower topped by a weather vane; at street level a sign reads "Ratskeller." Across the square are several shops and businesses with German signage painted on their facades. A fountain or monument stands near the center of the square, and a church spire rises in the background. A few pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the otherwise empty square.
